title: pseudotsuga taxifolia subsp. glaucescens
intro: Pseudotsuga taxifolia subsp. glaucescens, commonly known as Western White Fir, is a plant species that belongs to the Pinaceae family. Western White Fir has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Western White Fir include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Western White Fir include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
